questions.q: Three years ago, the average age of a family of 5 was 24 years. Two children were born since then (one 1 year older than the other), and today the average age of the family is 20 years. What is the present age of the younger child?
questions.why: Adults now 120 + 15 = 135; family of 7 totals 140, so children sum 5: ages 2 and 3. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

questions.q: Statements: All lions are tigers. No tiger is a dog. All dogs are cats. Conclusions: I. All lions are cats. II. Some cats are tigers.
questions.why: Lions and tigers have no link to cats; the cats that are dogs cannot be tigers, and nothing else is known. GPSC CBRT, Apr 2024.

questions.q: The Banker's Discount on a bill is 6/5 times the True Discount. If the rate of interest is numerically 5 times the number of years for which the bill is due, find the rate.
questions.why: BD/TD = 1 + RT/100 = 6/5, so RT = 20. With R = 5T: T = 2, R = 10%. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

questions.q: Is the average age of a school's students less than 17? I. Class VIII is under 25% of the school. II. Class VIII averages 18 years; the rest average 16.
questions.why: II alone allows any average between 16 and 18. With I, the weight of 18 is under 25%, so the average is below 16.5. GPSC CBRT, Apr 2024.

questions.q: The ratio of students ranked above Kavya to those below her is 2 : 3. The student exactly midway between Rank 1 and Kavya holds Rank 6. What is Kavya's rank from the bottom?
questions.why: (1 + k)/2 = 6 gives k = 11. 10 above, so 15 below: 16th from the bottom. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

questions.q: 4 men and 6 women finish a work in 8 days; 3 men and 7 women in 10 days. In how many days will 10 women finish it?
questions.why: 8(4m + 6w) = 10(3m + 7w), so m = 11w. Work = 400 woman-days; 10 women take 40 days. GPSC CBRT, Dec 2023.

questions.q: If TABLET is written as UCEPJZ in a certain code, how is HEALTH written in that code?
questions.why: In the code the 1st letter moves 1 place, the 2nd 2 places, the 3rd 3 places, and so on: HEALTH → IGDPYN. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Ten new TV shows appeared in September: five sitcoms, three hour-long dramas and two news-magazine shows. By January only seven were still on air, five of them sitcoms. Which statement must be true?
opts: Only one of the news-magazine shows remained on air
Only one of the hour-long dramas remained on air
At least one of the cancelled shows was an hour-long drama
Viewers prefer sitcoms over hour-long dramas
questions.why: Three cancelled shows came from the five non-sitcoms; only two are news shows, so at least one drama went. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2024.

questions.q: All X are Y. Some Y are Z. No Z is X. Which is true?
questions.why: 'No Z is X' turns round to 'No X is Z'. GPSC CBRT, Feb 2026.

questions.q: Ayesha's father was 38 when she was born; her mother was 36 when her brother, four years younger than Ayesha, was born. What is the difference between the parents' ages?
questions.why: When Ayesha was born her mother was 36 − 4 = 32 and her father 38: a gap of 6 years. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
